info.name: SportsBooks API
info.description:
Complete API collection for SportsBooks — Sports Venue & Coach Booking Platform.

All endpoints require Firebase Auth token (Bearer) unless noted.
Partner/Admin endpoints require role = 'partner' or 'admin'.

Stripe Test Card: 4242 4242 4242 4242 | Exp: 12/34 | CVC: 123 | ZIP: 42424

item.name: Time Slots
item.description: Time slot management. Generate creates hourly slots 09:00-22:00. Generate and Delete require partner/admin role.

item.name: Payments
item.description: Payment processing via Stripe. Platform collects 10% fee, rest goes to partner via Stripe Connect.
